sources.title: Model release announcements 2025
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 by downloading the original archive and reading its embedded article content after the web reader returned only the shell. The 202508 entry calls doubao-seed-1-6-vision-250815 a newly released visual-thinking model and compares its capabilities with doubao-seed-1-5-vision-pro. It provides neither a parameter count nor a statement that Vision is post-trained from the disclosed Seed1.6 base. The month-only release assessment is preserved.

sources.title: Migration guide for deprecated models
sources.evidence: Rendered table, updated September 21, 2026, places the exact Vision 250815 ID in the merged-cell group supporting thinking enabled by default and disabled. DOM row spans were checked. The separate auto group contains only generic Seed 1.6 250615. This documents legacy capabilities, not current endpoint operation.

sources.title: Coze model release notes: September 15, 2025
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The September 15, 2025 entry explicitly maps Doubao-Seed-1.6-Vision to vision 250815 and ByteDance, with video understanding, visual grounding, GUI-agent use, multimodal reasoning and a 256k context. It compares capabilities with Doubao-1.5-thinking-vision-pro, but gives no total/active count or named training lineage to the June Seed1.6 base. Coze availability follows the original Ark August release.

sources.title: doubao-seed-1-6-vision-250815 API overview
sources.evidence: Provider's exact-ID API page, dated September 30, 2025, documents text generation, image/video understanding, deep thinking and tools; the pricing table gives context as 256000. It is a historical serving specification, not proof of present operation.

sources.title: UI-TARS desktop: native streaming tool-call example
sources.evidence: ByteDance's example selects volcengine model doubao-seed-1-6-vision-250815, registers function tools, and explicitly sets toolCallEngine to native. The code's Apache-2.0 license does not license model weights.

sources.title: Doubao model service agreement
sources.evidence: Current Doubao-series service agreement reserves model ownership and intellectual property, and states that algorithms, parameters and source code are not supplied (sections 5.1-5.2). Supports proprietary hosted-service classification, not an open-weight license.

sources.title: Introduction to Techniques Used in Seed1.6
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 and read the original June 25 article in full. Seed1.6 pretraining uses nominal 230B total and 23B active parameters, and the article explicitly identifies Seed1.6-Thinking and Seed1.6 (Adaptive CoT) as two post-trained variants of that base. Both text and vision were already present during pretraining; adding vision is not itself a reason to reject those nominal counts. The linked model IDs are the June 250615 endpoints. The article does not name or map the later Vision 250815 model to this base. Neither exact deployed tensors nor hosted tool infrastructure is required for accepting a supported nominal count; the missing evidence here is the named Vision lineage.

sources.title: Aily model management: available model comparison
sources.evidence: Opened October 27, 2026. The first-party comparison table separately lists Doubao-Seed-1.6-vision 250815, Thinking 250615, Flash 250828 and generic Seed1.6 250615. Its columns are provider, model, version and capabilities; it supplies neither total nor activated parameters and does not identify Vision as a post-trained version of the disclosed June base. Tool-calling support is listed as a capability, not a parameter-bearing auxiliary component.

sources.title: Legacy Seed1.6 Vision documentation URL
sources.evidence: Followed on October 27, 2026. This historically cited exact-Vision documentation URL now redirects to https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/ark/model-list?redirect=1&lang=zh. The retrieved current model-list shell contains no 250815 entry or parameter evidence, so it cannot establish the missing lineage.

sources.title: TheRouter Seed1.6 Vision listing and current deprecation page
sources.evidence: Fresh search results exposed an earlier indexed listing asserting 230B/23B by reference to the generic Seed1.6 article. Reopening the live page returned a deprecation notice with no parameter count. The indexed claim was followed only as a lead: its generic-family citation supplies no additional first-party Vision250815 mapping and is not accepted as a verified model specification.

name.note: Normalized display name for Doubao-Seed-1.6-Vision, snapshot 250815; distinct from generic 1.6, Flash and Thinking.

developer.note: Exact release row identifies ByteDance as provider/developer.

family.note: Seed 1.6 Vision naming establishes the Seed family.

release_date.note: Original Ark announcement explicitly places the new model in August 2025. The 250815 suffix alone does not establish August 15 as public launch; Coze's September 15 listing is later distribution.

open_weights.note: Proprietary Doubao API model; service terms do not distribute model parameters or source code. No exact-variant open checkpoint was located.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the hosted model under Doubao service terms; not the license of example code.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 re-audit found no nominal total count for Vision250815 or explicit developer statement mapping it to the June Seed1.6 base (230B total). The June base-to-Thinking/Adaptive post-training relationship is explicit, but it does not name Vision. Original release material, later first-party model comparisons and four later cards supply no missing mapping or activated-parameter table. No pruning, distillation, expert expansion or other size-changing Vision training description was located; absence of such a description does not establish lineage. Hosted tools are not treated as model parameters, and no exact tensor attestation is demanded. The count remains unresolved because the model-to-base relationship is undisclosed.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 re-audit found no nominal active count for Vision250815 or explicit developer statement mapping it to the June Seed1.6 base (23B active). The June base-to-Thinking/Adaptive post-training relationship is explicit, but it does not name Vision. Original release material, later first-party model comparisons and four later cards supply no missing mapping or activated-parameter table. No pruning, distillation, expert expansion or other size-changing Vision training description was located; absence of such a description does not establish lineage. Hosted tools are not treated as model parameters, and no exact tensor attestation is demanded. The count remains unresolved because the model-to-base relationship is undisclosed.

architecture.note: No exact-variant architecture specification or first-party mapping located. The earlier generic Seed1.6 MoE description is insufficient to establish this later variant's architecture.

context_window.note: The exact Coze entry specifies nominal 256k; represented as 256000 consistently with the catalog convention. A serving-provider table corroborates 256000, but this is not an independently tested exact token ceiling.

modalities.note: Exact variant supports image/video understanding and text generation. No audio support inferred from unrelated RTC products or later models.

reasoning.note: Original announcement calls it visual-thinking; exact migration table supports enabled (default) and disabled thinking. Does not inherit generic 250615's auto mode.

tool_call.note: ByteDance's exact-ID example explicitly configures native function-tool calling.

description.value: ByteDance Seed multimodal model for image understanding, visual reasoning, and tool-assisted tasks
description.note: The existing concise description is supported by exact-variant release, capability and native-tool sources.

patch.notes: Audited as doubao-seed-1-6-vision-250815. Public launch is verified to August 2025 only; the snapshot suffix is not treated as a release-day announcement. Supports switchable deep thinking, video understanding and native tools. Nominal parameter counts remain undisclosed: the June Seed1.6 230B-total/23B-active disclosure names Thinking and Adaptive variants, but no developer source maps Vision250815 to that base. Architecture remains undisclosed. Specifications describe the legacy model, not a tested current endpoint.

sources.label: ByteDance Seed1.6 nominal counts and named post-training variants

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains null total and active counts after reopening the original release and Seed1.6 pretraining/post-training disclosure, checking the exact-version Coze and Feishu comparison tables, downloading four later first-party cards, and following fresh numeric and lineage search leads. The obstacle is the absent developer mapping from Vision250815 to the disclosed 230B/23B base, not a requirement for exact deployed tensor counts or hosted-service component accounting. Preserve the prior August 2025 month precision, proprietary license, reasoning, video input, 256000 context, native tools and undisclosed architecture assessments.
